ai_summary: Abans Financial Services Limited has announced a revision to its ESOP Scheme 2023 share allotment, citing an unspecified "operational issue" with an eligible grantee. The revised allotment now stands at 3,75,365 equity shares, which will increase the company's paid-up equity share capital to Rs. 10,24,30,248, comprising 5,12,15,124 shares. While the reason for the revision remains vague, the material impact is an overall increase in the company's total outstanding share capital.
